name: Calc Sheets
description: Line-oriented calculation worksheets with units, formulas, and live result gutters
author: Nimbalyst

marketplace.changelog:
1.0.3: Mix prose with formulas in a sheet, plus dependency security updates.
1.0.2: The results column in a shared calc sheet stays in sync with the document.
marketplace.tagline: Reusable business-model worksheets with live results
marketplace.longDescription: Open .calc.md files in a dedicated editor built for line-oriented assumptions, formulas, units, assertions, and quick business modeling. Mix calculations with narrative markdown source while live results stay focused in a calculator-style gutter.
highlights: Line-based worksheets instead of grid-heavy spreadsheets
Narrative markdown stays readable without becoming a calculation error
Live result gutter with unit-aware evaluation
Custom editor embeds directly inside markdown documents
YAML frontmatter for currency, units, and display defaults

screenshots.alt: Calc Sheets editor showing assumptions, formulas, and live result gutters
